name: Werewolf (roles mechanism)
description: Nine-player social deduction: 2 werewolves, 1 seer, 1 doctor, 5 villagers, dealt and hidden by the roles mechanism, with the day vote as a ballot.

brief.situation: Nine people live in a village. Two of them are secretly werewolves who kill one villager every night. Roles were dealt at random and are hidden: only the werewolves know each other.
brief.rules: Each round has a night and a day. Night: the werewolves agree on a victim, the seer inspects one living player and privately learns whether they are a werewolf, and the doctor protects one living player (not the same player two nights in a row); a protected victim survives. Day: the night's death is announced, living players talk in the public chat, then everyone votes at the same time to exile one player. The player with the most votes is exiled and their role revealed; a tie or no votes means nobody is exiled. Dead players take no further part. The village wins when both werewolves are dead. The werewolves win as soon as they equal or outnumber the other living players.

roles.player: Your role is shown in your update. Villagers, the seer and the doctor are the village side: find and exile the werewolves. Werewolves: stay hidden, deflect suspicion, and kill until you equal the village. Everything other players say in chat may be a lie.

whisper.description: At night: send a secret message to your fellow werewolf (e.g. who to kill and why).

choose_victim.description: At night: name the villager the pack should kill tonight. If the pack disagrees, one of its choices is picked by chance.

inspect_player.description: At night: secretly learn whether one living player is a werewolf.
do: $verdict = 'a WEREWOLF' if $params.target.role == werewolf else 'not a werewolf'

protect.description: At night: protect one living player (yourself allowed) from tonight's attack; not the same player two nights in a row.

exile.question: Who should the village exile?
exile.announce: The ballots are counted: {$join($map($filter($keys($result.counts), $get($result.counts, $it) > 0), $entity($it).name + ' ' + $text($get($result.counts, $it))), ', ') or 'nobody voted'}.

say.description: Day only: speak in the public village chat. Everyone living reads it.

text.description: What you say to the village.

say.outcome: You said it to the village.

done_talking.description: Day only: signal you have nothing more to say for now. Discussion ends when every living player is done (anyone speaking reopens it).

then.say: Both werewolves are dead. The village wins.
The werewolves now equal the village. The werewolves win.

stages.name: night_wolves
stages.brief: Night falls. Agree with your pack on tonight's victim: whisper, then choose. If you disagree, the choice is settled by chance.

stages.name: night_seer
stages.brief: Night. Choose one living player to inspect.

stages.name: night_doctor
stages.brief: Night. Choose one living player to protect.

then: $world.last_death = 'The werewolves did not strike last night.'
$world.last_death = 'Someone was attacked last night but survived: nobody died.'

else.say: Dawn of round {$round}: {$victim.name} was killed during the night.

else: $world.last_death = $victim.name + ' was killed during the night. They were a ' + $victim.role + '.'

stages.name: day_discussion
stages.brief: Day {$round}. Discuss who might be a werewolf. Say something, or mark yourself done.

stages.name: day_vote
stages.brief: Day {$round}. Vote to exile one player. Most votes is exiled; a tie means nobody is.

else.say: The vote is tied or empty: nobody is exiled.

visions.title: Your visions
visions.empty: You have not inspected anyone yet.

clinic.title: Your protection
clinic.show: {$'Last night you protected ' + $entity($actor.last_protected).name + ' (you cannot pick them again tonight).' if $actor.last_protected != '' else 'You have not protected anyone yet.'}

talking.title: Talking
talking.show: {$count(player, $it.living and $it.ready)} of {$count(player, $it.living)} living players are done talking.

rules.when: $stage == night_wolves and $actor.nomination == '' and $any(player, $it.role == werewolf and $it.living and $it.nomination != '')
$stage == day_discussion and $actor.role == seer and $any(player, $it.living and $it.role == werewolf and $it.id in $actor.inspected)

with.text: $text('I am the seer. ') + $pick(player, $it.living and $it.role == werewolf and $it.id in $actor.inspected).name + ' is a werewolf.'

rules.when: $stage == day_vote and $actor.role == seer and $any(player, $it.living and $it.role == werewolf and $it.id in $actor.inspected)

winning_side.description: village, werewolves, or none if the round budget ran out.
